title: Qualify the isolated AcDbDynamicBlockPurgePreventer DXF record profile

source.fixturePolicy: The existing DWG was read in place. Regression data is authored in test code; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.

independentWriterEvidence.observed: The independent conversion emitted class ACDB_DYNAMICBLOCKPURGEPREVENTER_VERSION, dictionary key AcDbDynamicBlockRoundTripPurgePreventer to 0x1122, and the PurgePreventer subclass with group 70 value 1.
Writes AcDbDynamicBlockPurgePreventer followed by group 70 Version. This is source-level corroboration, not an executed oracle result.

implementation.summary: Decode the exact ACDB_DYNAMICBLOCKPURGEPREVENTER_VERSION subclass and signed-16-bit group 70 field. Emit only that verified body with remapped object identity, owner and reactor. Stage its one-entry owner DICTIONARY and BLOCK_RECORD extension-dictionary edge; validate the source graph again at OBJECTS serialization. Register the class row and retain fail-closed behavior for other subclasses, mixed-key owner dictionaries and incomplete references.
implementation.scope: The isolated PurgePreventer record plus a singleton owner dictionary. The real title_block-arch.dwg owner dictionary has three entries and is not admitted by this slice; composing those sibling targets remains open. No native Dynamic Block behavior or format-wide claim is established.
